version role

  • CURIE: gmeow:versionRole
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/versionRole
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/versions

The role or status classification this membership asserts for the member within the set — canonical, variant, latest, stable, LTS, deprecated, yanked, draft, published, revised, collected, withdrawn. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an entity may hold multiple roles from different authorities simultaneously (standpoint-indexed coexistence per Principle 9), and a role may change over time via new memberships rather than overwrite.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:VersionMembership -> gmeow:VersionRole

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:versionRole from gmeow:VersionMembership to gmeow:VersionRole when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:VersionMembership, gmeow:VersionRole
